Subject: Your land dispute matter

Dear Ms. Reddy,

Thank you for meeting us on 14 July 2019 about your dispute with Varun Gaikwad. As we understand it, construction has started on the disputed plot. The matter is listed before the Thane District Court.

Our advice is to seek a temporary injunction to stop construction on the plot. Please collect photographs of the construction and the land records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 1,64,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
